user.title: New Nuki device
user.description: Connect a Nuki Bridge (local, recommended) and/or the Nuki Web API.

data.name: Entry name (optional)
data.address: Nuki bridge hostname or IP address (optional :port)
data.hass_url: Home Assistant URL for bridge callbacks (HTTP, empty = automatic)

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate {name}
reauth_confirm.description: The bridge rejected the API token. Enter the current token (Nuki app: Bridge > Manage > API).

error.no_devices: The bridge reports no paired devices
error.invalid_web_token: Error communicating with Nuki Web API
error.no_token: Either Bridge token or Web API token is required
error.https_not_supported: Bridge doesn't support HTTPS callbacks. Please make your Home Assistant accessible via HTTP
error.wrong_bridge: This token belongs to a different bridge

init.title: Configure Nuki device
init.description: Home Assistant URL used by the bridge for push updates (HTTP only). Leave empty to detect it automatically.

data.hass_url: Home Assistant URL for bridge callbacks (empty = automatic)

data_description.action_retries: Opening actions (open, unlatch, electric strike) are only repeated when the bridge certainly did not execute them, and never later than 35 s after the request.
data_description.auth_mode: Automatic uses the encrypted token (bridge firmware >= 2.14.0) and falls back to the deprecated hashed token. The plain token sends the secret unencrypted.

error.https_not_supported: Bridge doesn't support HTTPS callbacks. Please make your Home Assistant accessible via HTTP

callback_unreachable.title: Nuki bridge can't send push updates
callback_unreachable.description: The callback URL {url} is not reachable, so lock and opener states only update by polling. Set a reachable HTTP URL of Home Assistant in the Nuki Lock integration options (or leave it empty for automatic detection).

callback_slots_full.title: Nuki bridge has no free callback slot
callback_slots_full.description: All 3 callback slots of the Nuki bridge are used by other systems, so Home Assistant receives no push updates. Remove an unused callback (e.g. with the action nuki_ng.bridge_delete_callback).

bridge_fwupdate.name: Update bridge firmware
bridge_fwupdate.description: Checks for and installs firmware updates of the bridge and its devices (admin only).

bridge_delete_callback.name: Delete bridge callback
bridge_delete_callback.description: Removes a callback URL from the bridge (admin only).

device_id.name: Bridge
device_id.description: Nuki bridge (or a device connected to it)

execute_action.name: Execute lock action
execute_action.description: Runs a lock action on the targeted lock or opener and verifies it. Returns success, attempts and outcome (success, not_executed, unknown) per device.
